newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kuntien Asuntoluotto sets $750 mln EMTN programme.
newsitem.headline: Kuntien Asuntoluotto sets $750 mln EMTN programme.

text.p: Municipal housing finance group Kuntien Asuntoluotto said in a statement on Thursday it would launch a $750 million Euro Medium Term Note (EMTN) programme for bonds with various maturities.

"(It) is a programme within which Kuntien Asuntoluotto can issue up to a value of $750,000,000 bonds with various maturities in the currency it wants according to its needs," it said, adding this would expand its investor base and cut costs.
The programme would be guaranteed by the municipalities' guarantee centre and have the same Aa1 rating from Moody's as the government.
It was arranged by Salomon Brothers, ABN Amro Hoare Govett, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Credit Suisse First Boston, Daiwa Europe, JP Morgan Securities and Svenska Handelsbanken, it said.
